load_coco_panoptic_json: load COCO panoptic segmentation annotations from a JSON file into Detectron2 standard format dicts
register_coco_panoptic: register a standard COCO panoptic segmentation dataset with the DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
register_coco_panoptic_separated: register a separated COCO panoptic dataset with instance and semantic annotations merged
merge_to_panoptic: merge detection dicts and semantic segmentation dicts into panoptic segmentation dataset dicts
run_coco_panoptic_cli: run the COCO panoptic dataset loader CLI to visualize panoptic segmentation annotations
